description: This Java source file defines the PredefinedShelf entity class, which represents predefined, non-deletable shelves in the book project application. It includes enumerations for shelf names, JPA annotations for persistence, and Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

classes.name: PredefinedShelf
classes.description: Entity class representing a predefined, immutable shelf in the book application. It extends Shelf and includes properties such as id, predefinedShelfName, and associated books, with JPA and Lombok annotations for persistence and boilerplate code reduction.
